title: Canonical CI workflow registration context repair

phases.objective: Restore registration of the canonical CI workflow by removing a runner context from jobs.<job_id>.env while preserving the governed closure trigger, authority, evidence path, and full CI command surface.

e2e_journeys.actor: GitHub Actions workflow registrar and pull-request runner
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A same-repository pull request targets main after ci.yml moves EVIDENCE_PATH from job env to the bounded closure execution step.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: GitHub materializes the workflow named CI, ordinary CI jobs run, and the dormant push-only governed closure retains the same token, permissions, script, artifact path, and no-migration/no-provider-mutation boundary.
steps: Read the canonical CI workflow and isolate the governed local-connector closure job declaration from its steps.
Reject runner.temp inside jobs.<job_id>.env, where runner context is unavailable during workflow registration.
Bind EVIDENCE_PATH to runner.temp only on the bounded closure execution step.
Upload the same evidence filename directly from runner.temp.
Retain the pull-request trigger, push-only one-shot closure condition, token, permissions, and script invocation.
Observe creation of the workflow named CI on the exact pull-request head and run the complete recovery, E2E, and registration regression checks.
assertions: The canonical workflow remains named CI and continues targeting main and Production pull requests.
runner.temp is absent from the closure job declaration and job-level env.
The execution step and artifact upload use the same runner-temp evidence filename.
The governed closure remains push-only and one-shot-token bound.

No trigger broadening, permission increase, secret exposure, deployment, Hostinger/provider mutation, SQL, migration Apply, database mutation, protected-ref mutation, or external business send is introduced.

phases.objective: Verify canonical CI registration across opened, synchronize, and ready-for-review pull-request events.
Reject future unavailable workflow contexts before they suppress workflow registration.
Prove Draft and Ready exact-head cycles with both canonical CI and CI Pull Request Recovery visible.
Retire the temporary recovery workflow only after canonical CI registration remains stable across governed pull requests.
